propDocs.Tabs.orientation: Controls the layout and arrow-key axis.
propDocs.Tabs.activation: Automatic selects on focus; manual waits for Enter or Space.
propDocs.Tabs.loop: Wraps arrow-key focus at either end.
propDocs.Tabs.hiddenUntilFound: Keeps panels available for find in page.
propDocs.TabsTab.disabled: Keeps focusable tabs from being selected.
